# Vectors: payload-constructed

Guideline baseline: `734c560` · Kind: payload · 151 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

Constructed payload vectors for the two validation modes of MG 8 (SF-052): strict validation reports every key that is not defined for the object (REQ-MSG-001, conformance of the sender), tolerant validation ignores such keys (REQ-MSG-046, view of a tolerant receiver). Without mode a vector is checked strictly. Since C-027 also invalid variants of golden vectors that each violate one rule of the resource content checks (Health, Pagination, MAM, PublicationList; since C-028 Event, Oi4Pv, SubscriptionList and Get Metadata; since C-029 Config; since C-035 the MetaData objects of MG 8.2.2 … 8.2.15). Since C-035 also messages with a declared role (field role: Birth, Close, Will; Q-020 (a)).

## V-PAY-245

**Pub MAM whose generated Oi4Identifier has an unmasked reserved character**

- Topic: `Oi4v2/OTConnector/cHJvdmlkZXIuY29tL0ZpZWxkRGF0YVNlcnZpY2UvRkRTLTAwMS8xMjAwLTAzNDU/Pub/MAM/cHJvdmlkZXIuY29tL0ZpZWxkRGF0YVNlcnZpY2UvRkRTLTAwMS9BQkNAaG9tZQ`
- ServiceType · Method · Resource: OTConnector · Pub · MAM ([matrix](../../matrix/view/method-resource.md#mam))
- AppId: `provider.com/FieldDataService/FDS-001/1200-0345` (decoded)
- Source: `provider.com/FieldDataService/FDS-001/ABC@home` (decoded)
- Expected: invalid – The elements of a generated Oi4Identifier are dnp-encoded (REQ-IL-033, SF-104): the SerialNumber ABC@home is ABC,40home.
- Violates: [REQ-RES-MAM-006](../../requirements/view/res-mam.md#req-res-mam-006)
- Origin: constructed
- Status: reviewed

Notes: Drafted in C-046 addendum 2 after the PO decision on SF-104 (MG 4.1 governs, the masking is mandatory). V-PAY-210 as the MAM of an asset with the SerialNumber ABC@home; ProductInstanceUri and DataSetWriterName carry it unmasked. "@" is permitted in an Identification Link, so only the Oi4Identifier rule is violated; REQ-IL-033 itself is manual, D7 checks it through the heuristic of REQ-RES-MAM-006 (ADR-0019 §5, R-3). Valid with provider.com/FieldDataService/FDS-001/ABC,40home.
